sectors.rule: Each storm is assigned by the longitude of its FIRST recorded position: west of 77.5E = Arabian Sea side, otherwise Bay of Bengal side. This is an approximate rule made for this analysis; the basin field of IBTrACS is not in the supplied file.

intensity_change.definition: wind at +24 h minus wind now, both from IBTrACS; RI = rise of 30 kt or more

methods.analog: Dashboard's simulated outlook (copies a similar historical storm), storm itself excluded
methods.stay: Baseline: storm stays where it is
methods.motion: Baseline: keeps moving at its last 6 h speed and direction
methods.hold: Baseline for wind: stays at the starting (class-midpoint) wind

backtest.assumptions: Start wind = midpoint of the true IMD class band (what the dashboard uses when an image is given), so this assumes the classifier was right. Only windows with 6 h of past track and 24 h of future track at a regular 3 h spacing are scored.

reported._note: Aggregate numbers copied from MODAK.ipynb's cell 21 'ENSEMBLE v3b+s1' row. mean_error_severity_levels and ece_pct_approx come from a later per-image export cell added to the same notebook (v3_ensemble_test_predictions.csv), which replicates backend/predict.py's exact math per image. severe_cyclonic_storm_correct is still null - the export has the data to compute it, but a per-class breakdown hasn't been pulled from it yet. Do not backfill any of this with the old v2 model's numbers.
reported.source: MODAK.ipynb cell 21 ('ENSEMBLE v3b+s1' row) + the per-image export cell added after it (v3_ensemble_test_predictions.csv) - matches backend/model_card.py
reported.mean_error_severity_levels_note: Computed from a per-image export added to MODAK.ipynb right after cell 21's scoring cell: replicates backend/predict.py's exact ensemble + 4-rotation averaging for each of the 520 test images to get a predicted class, then averages |predicted class - true class|. Saved as v3_ensemble_test_predictions.csv in the team's Drive.
reported.ece_pct_note: Computed from the same per-image export (10 equal-width confidence bins, 0-100%), using each image's actual derived confidence from backend/wind_math.py's Normal-CDF formula (not a measured softmax - see model_card.py's known_failure_modes). Much lower than v2's ~27%, though the two aren't measuring the same kind of confidence, so this shows the derived confidence tracks accuracy reasonably well - it isn't a direct apples-to-apples improvement over v2's ECE.
reported.severe_cyclonic_storm_correct_note: Not available - needs the v3 ensemble's per-image predictions on the 79 Severe Cyclonic Storm test images specifically, which were never exported from the notebook (only the aggregate 53.7%/93.1% numbers were printed).

computed.macro_f1_note: average of the F1 of classes that occur in this file
